description: This file contains a test class CsvDataImportServiceTest that verifies functionality of CsvDataImportService related to parsing CSV files containing employee data, including handling of line breaks, special characters, and invalid CSV content.

classes.name: CsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: Test suite for CsvDataImportService, testing CSV parsing capabilities and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes CsvDataImportService and header values before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNormalCSVContent
methods.description: Tests parsing of standard CSV content with header and data row.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithLineBreaksInCSV
methods.description: Tests handling of line breaks within quoted CSV fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithSpecialCharactersInCSV
methods.description: Tests handling of special characters like carriage returns, tabs, and null bytes within CSV fields.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeArrayFromCSVWithNonCSVContent
methods.description: Tests exception handling when provided content is not valid CSV.
